verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly support BYOK (bring your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local runtimes) as an alternative to signing in with a Cline account for credits, and pricing page confirms users are never locked into platform login/pricing and can switch providers or self-host. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of API-key-only auth flow and details on any limitations when skipping account login.
